# Aidentity Setup Prompt: Founder / Startup builder (Individual)

Set up my AI agent environment for the **Founder / Startup builder** role using the **Individual** profile.

## 1. One-Command Automated Setup (Preferred)
If you have shell access in this workspace, run:
```bash
npx aidentity setup founder --profile individual --agent claude
```

## 2. Security & Provenance Gate (Mandatory)
Before installing or loading any skill, rule, or hook:
1. Verify against `https://akshatnaruka.github.io/aidentity/security.json` (or local `registry/security.json`) that `verified === true` and `risk_level === "safe"`.
2. Never install any skill where `distributable === false`, `content_url === null`, or `status !== "stable"`.
3. State the upstream author, SPDX license, and SHA-256 verification status before installing.
4. **Individual Guardrails**: Enable `block-dangerous.js` and `scan-secrets.js` to prevent accidental destructive commands or credential leaks.

Why Use Aidentity Setup Instead of Default Agent Prompts

Deterministic

Zero "Hallucinated" Skills

Raw agent prompts often invent non-existent packages or install untrusted dependencies. Aidentity enforces strict SHA-256 cryptographic verification against security.json before any file is created.

Security Guardrails

Supply-Chain & Hook Gates

Enterprise profiles automatically attach pre-push security hooks, secret sanitization, and AST blockers that intercept destructive shell commands like rm -rf, curl | sh, or credential leaks.

Multi-Platform

1 Command · 6 Coding Agents

Whether your team works in Claude Code (.claude/skills), Cursor (.cursor/rules), Codex, OpenCode, Copilot, or Gemini CLI, one single flag adapts the layout without rewriting your team's guidelines.

Setup Frequently Asked Questions

How does the one-time initial setup work? ▶
Copy the prompt generated above and paste it once into your coding agent's chat window (e.g. Claude Code or Cursor). The agent reads the instructions, inspects your local workspace, and installs the verified SKILL.md files, project rules, and subagents specified for your profile into the standard directory structure.
What is the difference between Individual and Enterprise profiles? ▶
Individual is tuned for solo speed, prototyping, and MVP velocity with core sanity checks. Enterprise enforces pre-commit verification, architectural decision records (ADRs), 7-gate static analysis, prompt injection blockers, and formal license attestation.
Do I need shell access to install these skills? ▶
If you have shell access in your agent, running npx aidentity setup <role> is the fastest method. If you do not have shell access, the generated setup prompt instructs the agent to download and write the verified SKILL.md files directly using its file-writing tools.
